summary: Sequential verification found no critical errors or gaps. The statement is self-contained. The statements and relevant proofs of accepted facts 7aedefba09125cf6, 1e514828f5fb6c04, and 47409d3a276b6039 were read; they supply the stated arithmetic coefficient, weighted Chern nonvanishing, and relative cyclic product comparison, with no inherited unproven conditional premise. Step 1 uses the correct spectral-completion convention. The transfer, base-change, projection-formula, localization, devissage, and continuity inputs match [Weibel's K-book](https://sites.math.rutgers.edu/~weibel/Kbook/Kbook.pdf). Step 2 correctly proves regularity and constructs an actual integral supported class, with both integral generic vanishings. Step 3 establishes the properties of B and constructs an essentially smooth R-model of cotangent rank two, satisfying the comparison fact's hypotheses. In Step 4 the relative coefficient lift exists uniquely, and its coordinate is compatible with coefficient extension by the natural constructions in [AMMN, Theorem A and Proposition 4.10](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2003.12541). The Chern detector therefore gives a nonzero completed relative class. [Geisser-Levine, Theorem 8.4](https://www2.rikkyo.ac.jp/web/geisser/p-part.pdf) states exactly the required finite-coefficient vanishing, with the coefficient convention used here. Its application to the smooth two-dimensional models and passage through filtered colimits and the Milnor exact sequence establish the required degree-three and degree-four vanishings. The reduction and support fiber sequences consequently yield the two asserted injections. Step 5 correctly constructs the maps from A and its completion, splits the supported divisor after flat coefficient extension, and identifies the pulled-back Cartier ideals and actual K-class with the detected class. Nonzero image in the characteristic-zero completed target proves infinite order without assuming injectivity of actual K-theory into spectral completion. Together with the integral generic vanishings, this proves both nonzero rational kernels. No hard prohibition is violated.
